claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM for 5 days, aspirin is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent; any antiproliferative effect would be weak and non-selective, plausibly reflecting salicylate-mediated inhibition of NF-kB/IKK or AMPK activation rather than COX inhibition.
